newsitem.title: USA: JC Penney's $2 bln debt deal gets set for takeoff.
newsitem.headline: JC Penney's $2 bln debt deal gets set for takeoff.

text.p: J.C. Penney Co Inc's $2.0 billion multi-tranche debt offering is expected to be launched as early as Tuesday, syndicate sources said on Monday.
The deal is expected to consist of the following five tranches, syndicate sources said.
-- $600 million in five-year debt with price talk seen between 45 and 50 basis points over U.S. Treasuries.
-- $400 million in 10-year debt with price talk seen at 70 basis points over Treasuries.
-- $300 million in 20-year bonds with price talk seen at +85 basis points.
-- $350 million in 30-year debt, callable after 10 years, with price talk seen in the +120 basis points area.
-- $350 million in 40-year bonds, putable in eight years, with price talk seen in the mid-40's.
Credit Suisse First Boston is expected to serve as lead underwriter for the deal.
